title: Step
description: One card in a procedure. Always has two exits: capture, or state why not.

condition.description: Show only if. Null means always.

explanation.description: WHY this step exists and what goes wrong without it. Authored by the Scoper during the interview.

max_add_fields.description: Hard cap on Inspector ADD FIELD. On exhaustion the step escalates with the unresolved question.

required_at_strictness.description: 0 log, 1 standard, 2 assured, 3 regulated; 4 means never required. The step is required at or above this. Absent reads as 0 — a step that does not say otherwise is required, because the safe default for a maintenance step is that somebody has to do it. A step below the job's strictness is still SHOWN and still performable; what it loses is the power to hold the seal open.
